notes: Golden decisions for the trap fixture (ADR-0007, scripts/decision_report.py). A correct assessment must SKIP what the project already covers and cite the real file, must not be fooled by a rule whose name matches, must ASK for hooks and MCP servers, and must notice that a ruff-format hook already exists. `SKIP|ASK` accepts either verdict where the rubric allows a judgement call. Reviewed by the maintainers against the rubric, not against a model run; the first real runs replace the `|` alternatives with what a careful reviewer accepted.
